title: (fix) Filter conditions query to problem-list-item category

## Summary

The conditions widget fetched all FHIR `Condition` resources for a patient regardless of category, which surfaced non–problem-list entries (e.g. encounter-diagnosis conditions) in the conditons list.

This PR adds a `category` filter to the `useConditions` FHIR query so it only returns problem-list-item conditions, so that encounter-diagnoses (diagnoses added from the visit note form) do not appear in the conditions table:

```
${fhirBaseUrl}/Condition?patient=${patientUuid}&category=http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-category|problem-list-item&_count=100
```

These changes do not affect the search for conditions when trying to record a condition for a patient.
